_comment: The pinned embedding model. Changing anything here invalidates the stored corpus
vectors, the stored query vectors, and every recorded generation downstream of them,
because retrieved control ids change and retrieved text is part of the hashed prompt.
There is no partial re-record for an embedder change. See docs/decisions/embedder.md
for what was measured before pinning it.
